title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 5,551–5,600 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 微縮模型；微型的；袖珍的

examples.en: Painting tiny fantasy miniatures with intricate armor details requires steady hands and fine brushes.
examples.zh: 為精細的奇幻微縮模型盔甲塗裝上細膩紋路，需要極度平穩的雙手與超細面相筆。

examples.en: The dollhouse was filled with charming miniature furniture, including a tiny wooden dining set.
examples.zh: 這棟玩具娃娃屋裡擺滿了精巧迷人的袖珍微縮家具，甚至包括一套小巧玲瓏的原木餐桌椅。

examples.en: Growing up, he built miniature airplane models and hung them from his bedroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 在成長過程中，他熱衷於親手組裝各種微型飛機模型，並把它們一一懸吊在臥室的天花板下。

words.definition: 模型比例尺 (如 1/35 軍事坦克)

examples.en: The museum features a 1:35 scale historical diorama depicting a famous desert tank battle.
examples.zh: 歷史博物館展出了一座 1:35 精密比例立體情境模型，逼真重現著名的沙漠坦克戰役。

examples.en: The architects built a large physical scale model of the proposed city sports center.
examples.zh: 建築師團隊親手搭建了一座大型實體比例模型，向市府委員具體展示規劃中的市立體育中心。

examples.en: Stepping on the bathroom scale each morning helps him track his personal fitness progress.
examples.zh: 每天清晨起床後站上浴室體重計磅秤量體重，有助於他持續追蹤個人減重健身的成效。

words.definition: 塑膠模型組裝零件框架 (澆道框架)

examples.en: Modelers inspect the plastic parts on the runner sprue carefully before clipping them out.
examples.zh: 模型玩家在用剪鉗剪下零件前，會對著組裝說明書仔細核對零件框架上的編號。

examples.en: Each sprue letter corresponds to specific component trees listed in the assembly manual.
examples.zh: 框架上標示的每一個英文字母代號，皆嚴格對應組裝說明書中所列出的特定零件框架樹。

examples.en: Leftover sprue frames can be melted down with liquid cement to create custom modeling putty.
examples.zh: 剩下的廢棄模型塑膠澆道框架可以用模型膠水溶解，自製成同色系的流動性模型補土。

words.definition: 模型專用單刃超薄斜口剪鉗

examples.en: High-precision single-blade nippers slice through polystyrene gates smoothly like a knife through butter.
examples.zh: 高精密單刃模型專用斜口剪，能如熱刀切奶油般平整俐落切斷塑膠注道。

examples.en: Store your expensive nippers in a protective leather sheath to prevent chipping the delicate cutting edge.
examples.zh: 請將昂貴的高階單刃斜口剪收納在專用皮革保護套中，以防嬌貴的超薄刀刃受撞擊崩口。

examples.en: Using dull nippers can crush the plastic gate, causing ugly stress marks on colored parts.
examples.zh: 使用鈍掉的劣質斜口鉗粗暴剪切零件，容易擠壓塑膠注道，在深色零件表面留下難看的白化應力白化痕跡。

words.definition: 剪切零件遺留之微小塑膠湯口

examples.en: Shaving down the excess plastic nub with a hobby knife prevents unsightly gaps during assembly.
examples.zh: 用筆刀小心削平剪切後殘留的微小塑膠湯口，能防止零件密合時產生難看的縫隙。

examples.en: Sanding sponges of varying grits are ideal for polishing away remaining gate nubs without scratching adjacent plastic.
examples.zh: 搭配使用不同番數的砂磨海綿，能在不刮傷周圍塑料的前提下將殘留的注道湯口打磨得平滑如鏡。

examples.en: Take your time trimming each nub flush with the surface to achieve a seamless finish.
examples.zh: 沉下心來耐心地將每個零件上的湯口修整至與表面齊平，才能確保組裝後擁有天衣無縫的密合度。

words.definition: 模型專用高流動性溜縫膠水；黏合

examples.en: Capillary action draws extra-thin plastic cement into the seam, chemically welding the parts together.
examples.zh: 毛細現象將高流動性模型溜縫膠水瞬間吸入接縫，透過塑膠微熔接形成堅固結合。

examples.en: Construction workers poured fresh concrete cement into the deep foundational trenches.
examples.zh: 營建工人們俐落地將攪拌均勻的新鮮混凝土水泥，源源澆灌進深邃厚實的建築基礎溝槽中。

examples.en: A successful collaborative project helped cement a lifelong professional friendship between the two researchers.
examples.zh: 一次大獲成功的跨國科研合作專案，徹底鞏固並深化了這兩位青年學者之間終生相惜的深厚友誼。

words.definition: AB 補土原子灰 (填補接縫縮水)

examples.en: Spreading two-part polyester putty over sink marks allows modelers to sand surfaces completely flat.
examples.zh: 在塑膠縮水凹痕上薄塗雙劑型模型補土，能讓製作者砂磨出完美平整的無瑕表面。

examples.en: The glazier used window putty around the frame to secure the glass pane and block drafts.
examples.zh: 裝裱玻璃門窗師傅在窗框周圍細心塗抹上一圈防水油灰油膏，以固定玻璃窗板並阻擋寒風滲入。

examples.en: Allow the epoxy putty to cure for twenty-four hours before carving sharp mechanical panel contours.
examples.zh: 請耐心等待環氧樹脂 AB 造型補土靜置固化二十四小時後，再動刀雕刻銳利洗鍊的裝甲機械刻線。

words.definition: 零件組合接縫 (無縫處理工序)

examples.en: Eliminating the prominent fuselage seam line requires careful gluing, scraping, and progressive sanding.
examples.zh: 消除飛機機身兩半組合時的明顯接縫線，需要耐心溢膠、刮除與漸進式打磨。

examples.en: The tailor reinforced the trouser seam with double stitching to prevent tearing during movement.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的老裁縫師在西裝褲後襠接縫處採用雙道密針加固縫紉，以防大幅度跨步時發生開線撕裂。

examples.en: Geologists discovered a rich coal seam running through the deep strata of the mountain range.
examples.zh: 地質勘探隊員在險峻山脈深處的古老沉積岩地層中，驚喜探勘到一條蘊藏豐富的優質煤炭煤層。

words.definition: 噴塗水補土底漆 (提高面漆附著力)

examples.en: Spraying a smooth coat of grey surfacer primer reveals hidden scratches while enhancing paint adhesion.
examples.zh: 噴塗上一層細緻的灰色水補土底漆，既能揪出細微刮痕，又能大幅提升面漆咬合附著力。

examples.en: Applying an oil-based primer on bare drywall creates an even surface before painting the living room walls.
examples.zh: 在未處理的清水石膏板牆面上滾塗一道油性封閉底漆，能在客廳刷上乳膠漆前創造均勻吸附的平整基底。

examples.en: The university professor published an introductory primer covering the fundamental laws of quantum physics.
examples.zh: 這位知名物理學教授親筆撰寫並出版了一本圖文並茂的入門初級讀本，通俗講解量子力學基本定律。

words.definition: 雙動式重力模型噴筆 (噴槍)；噴塗

examples.en: Dual-action gravity-feed airbrushes allow artists to spray razor-thin camouflage lines effortlessly.
examples.zh: 雙動式重力進漆模型噴筆，能讓塗裝師得心應手噴出極細的迷彩漸層線條。

examples.en: Disassembling and deep cleaning your airbrush nozzle after each session prevents dried paint clogs.
examples.zh: 每次完成模型噴塗後徹底拆解並深度清洗噴筆噴嘴與噴針，能完全杜絕殘漆硬化堵塞通道。

examples.en: The car customizer used an airbrush to paint fiery dragon graphics along the motorcycle fuel tank.
examples.zh: 痛車彩繪改裝大師手持精密噴槍，在重型機車的金屬烤漆油箱兩側噴繪出栩栩如生的烈火巨龍圖騰。

words.definition: 模型靜音氣泵空壓機 (附調壓閥)

examples.en: The oil-free desktop compressor runs silently, delivering steady twenty-PSI air pressure without pulsation.
examples.zh: 無油桌上型靜音空壓機運轉極為安靜，能穩定輸出二十 PSI 氣壓且完全無脈動氣流。

examples.en: Remember to drain the moisture trap on your air compressor tank after humid summer painting sessions.
examples.zh: 在潮濕悶熱的夏季進行噴漆作業後，切記務必手動排空空壓機濾水器儲水杯中沉積的冷凝水。

examples.en: Industrial compressors power assembly lines with high-pressure air across the automated factory floor.
examples.zh: 智慧無人化工廠產線上裝設有大型工業級空氣壓縮機，源源不絕為全廠氣動機械手臂輸送高壓氣源。

words.definition: 水簾抽風排氣模型噴漆箱

examples.en: A lighted desktop spray booth with high-velocity exhaust fans evacuates toxic paint fumes safely outdoors.
examples.zh: 配備高風速排氣風扇與 LED 照明的桌上型噴漆箱，將有害漆霧安全抽出窗外。

examples.en: Visitors queued up outside the exhibition booth to try the new virtual reality gaming demo.
examples.zh: 參觀展覽的熱情民眾在科技大廠的展覽攤位前大排長龍，爭相搶先體驗最新發表的虛擬實境遊戲。

examples.en: She stepped into the soundproof recording booth to lay down voiceover tracks for the commercial.
examples.zh: 她緩步走進專業隔音錄音間配音室，在安靜無噪的環境中為即將上映的電視商業廣告錄製旁白。

words.definition: 雙罐式有機溶劑防護防毒面具

examples.en: Wearing a dual-cartridge organic vapor respirator protects lungs from hazardous aerosolized solvents.
examples.zh: 噴漆時務必配戴雙濾毒罐有機溶劑防毒面具，全面阻絕有害化學揮發氣體吸入肺部。

examples.en: Intensive care hospital beds are equipped with mechanical respirators for patients with acute lung injury.
examples.zh: 醫學中心加護病房病床旁皆配備有高階醫療級人工呼吸器，全力搶救急性呼吸衰竭重症病患。

examples.en: Replace the charcoal filters on your respirator immediately if you can smell chemical paint odors through the mask.
examples.zh: 倘若你在噴漆時能隔著防毒面罩隱隱嗅到化學油漆溶劑氣味，代表濾毒罐已飽和失效，必須立刻更換活性碳濾片。

words.definition: 硝基漆模型漆 (發色鮮艷耐刮金屬光澤)

examples.en: Lacquer paints dry rapidly with rock-hard durability, ideal for airbrushing mirror-like chrome finishes.
examples.zh: 揮發迅速的硝基模型漆乾燥後漆膜堅硬耐刮，是噴塗如鏡面般電鍍銀漆的最佳選擇。

examples.en: The antique Chinese cabinet was protected by twenty coats of hand-rubbed glossy black tree lacquer.
examples.zh: 這件歷經數百年的明代古董櫥櫃，表面塗覆了多達二十道手工推光的烏黑天然生漆大漆保護。

examples.en: Because lacquer solvents are potent, always spray lacquer paints in a well-ventilated space with a mask.
examples.zh: 由於硝基漆專用溶劑極具揮發性與刺激氣味，噴塗時務必在通風良好且開啟排風箱的環境下配戴面具。

words.definition: 環保水性壓克力水漆 (無毒無味)

examples.en: Water-based acrylic hobby paints are odorless and clean up easily with plain water, perfect for home desks.
examples.zh: 環保無毒的水性壓克力水漆完全沒有刺鼻臭味，清水即可洗筆，非常適合在書房塗裝。

examples.en: The artist painted an expressive abstract landscape on canvas using heavy body acrylic pigments.
examples.zh: 青年畫家在粗紋油畫畫布上揮灑厚塗重彩型壓克力水性顏料，創做出富有生命力的大地抽象畫。

examples.en: Transparent acrylic sheets are widely used as shatterproof protective screens in retail bank counters.
examples.zh: 晶瑩剔透的高透光壓克力壓克力板被廣泛安裝於銀行與郵局臨櫃櫃檯，作為防飛沫撞擊的防護隔板。

words.definition: 琺瑯漆滲線墨線液 (毛細流動)

examples.en: Applying dark brown enamel wash into armor panel lines creates crisp shadowing through capillary flow.
examples.zh: 將黑褐色琺瑯漆滲線液點入裝甲刻線上，藉由毛細現象流動勾勒出清晰銳利的陰影。

examples.en: High-heat porcelain enamel coatings protect the interior oven walls from burnt food splatters.
examples.zh: 高溫燒結的耐高溫陶瓷琺瑯塗層能全面包覆烤箱內壁，讓油污菜汁不易沾附且極易擦拭清潔。

examples.en: Brushing your teeth twice daily with fluoride toothpaste helps protect precious tooth enamel from decay.
examples.zh: 每天早晚使用含氟牙膏細心刷牙兩次，能強化並保護牙齒表面珍貴脆弱的琺瑯質免受蛀牙酸蝕。

words.definition: 模型專用緩乾溶劑稀釋劑

examples.en: Adding a few drops of leveling thinner prevents the airbrush paint from drying in mid-air before hitting the plastic.
examples.zh: 在噴筆漆杯中加入幾滴添加緩乾劑的專用稀釋劑，能防止漆霧在空中提早乾燥產生橘皮顆粒。

examples.en: Paint thinner should be stored in tightly capped metal cans away from heat sources and open flames.
examples.zh: 工業用松香水與油漆稀釋劑必須存放於旋緊蓋子的密封鐵罐中，並時刻遠離高溫火源與明火。

examples.en: Diluting dense paints with the correct proportion of thinner ensures smooth atomization through the airbrush nozzle.
examples.zh: 嚴格依照黃金比例添加正確的溶劑稀釋劑稀釋濃稠顏料，能確保漆料在噴筆噴嘴處達成極致細膩的霧化效果。

words.definition: 水漆保濕濕調色盤 (數天不乾)

examples.en: A homemade wet palette with moist sponge paper keeps mixed acrylic paints workable for three days.
examples.zh: 鋪有濕海綿與烘焙紙的保濕濕調色盤，能讓調配好的水漆在三日內維持濕潤不結塊。

examples.en: The interior designer recommended a neutral color palette featuring warm beige, off-white, and natural wood tones.
examples.zh: 室內軟裝設計師向屋主大力推薦一套以溫潤米白、大地淺灰與天然原木色為主的百搭中性色彩調色盤配色方案。

examples.en: The classical painter loaded oil paints onto his wooden thumb-hole palette before starting the portrait.
examples.zh: 這位古典油畫大師在正式動筆繪製人物肖像之前，從容將各色油畫顏料整齊擠在手握的胡桃木指孔調色盤上。

words.definition: 柯林斯基頂級貂毛面相筆；紫貂

examples.en: Miniature artists invest in pure Kolinsky sable brushes for their razor-sharp tips and springy elasticity.
examples.zh: 微縮模型大師指定使用純柯林斯基貂毛筆，其聚鋒極尖銳且筆鋒回彈彈性絕佳。

examples.en: The Russian winter coat was trimmed with soft, luxurious natural sable fur around the collar.
examples.zh: 這件歷史悠久的俄羅斯傳統保暖冬季大衣，在領口四周滾飾了一圈觸感極致奢華柔軟的天然黑貂貂皮毛。

examples.en: Washing sable brushes gently with lukewarm water and brush conditioning soap keeps the natural bristles healthy.
examples.zh: 每次使用後用溫水搭配專用洗筆皂溫柔洗滌純貂毛筆，能滋潤毛鱗片並長久保持天然毛刷的聚鋒彈性。

words.definition: 均勻薄塗兩層發色底色面漆

examples.en: Applying two thin basecoats rather than one thick layer preserves the miniature's crisp sculpted details.
examples.zh: 堅持薄塗兩層底色而非一次塗厚，能完整保留微縮雕塑細節而不被顏料糊死。

examples.en: The auto repair technician sprayed a metallic silver basecoat before applying the high-gloss clear varnish.
examples.zh: 汽車板金修復技師在噴塗高光澤耐磨透明金油面漆之前，先均勻噴塗了一層金屬銀粉底漆色漆。

examples.en: Ensure the primer is completely dry before brushing on your acrylic basecoat to avoid paint peeling.
examples.zh: 在手繪刷塗水性壓克力底色顏料之前，務必確認底層水補土已完全乾透，以徹底防止日後面漆剝落。

words.definition: 陰影漬洗墨水 (沉積凹槽陰影)；洗滌

examples.en: Applying an acrylic shade wash across sculpted muscles flows into recesses, instantly creating dramatic depth.
examples.zh: 在雕刻出的肌肉紋理上刷上一層陰影漬洗液，墨水沉入凹縫中瞬間創造出強烈立體感。

examples.en: Remember to wash your hands with antibacterial soap and warm water before handling fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 在廚房動手處理生鮮蔬果與食材之前，切記務必用抑菌洗手乳與溫水將雙手徹底沖洗洗乾淨。

examples.en: The ocean tide leaves a gentle wash of white foam across the sandy shoreline at sunset.
examples.zh: 傍晚落日餘暉下，拍岸的海水退潮時在金黃平緩的沙灘邊緣留下一道道如蕾絲般細膩溫柔的白色浪花浪沫。

words.definition: 乾掃技法 (毛筆輕刷凸顯邊緣高光)

examples.en: Drybrushing light grey paint across rough stone walls highlights raised stony textures within seconds.
examples.zh: 用幾乎擦乾顏料的扁筆在粗糙石牆上快速乾掃，能在數秒內凸顯凸起石塊的高光。

examples.en: Practice drybrushing on a textured paper towel first to wipe off 95% of the paint from the bristles.
examples.zh: 先在有凹凸紋理的廚房紙巾上進行乾掃試筆，直到將筆刷上百分之九十五的濕潤顏料完全拭去為止。

examples.en: Miniature terrain builders use drybrushing techniques to quickly bring out bark textures on foam trees.
examples.zh: 微縮場景地形模型製作達人廣泛運用乾掃技法，快速凸顯泡棉微縮樹幹表面嶙峋起伏的逼真樹皮紋理。

words.definition: 極細邊緣高光刻劃；強調

examples.en: Painting crisp edge highlights with pure bone white makes armor plates pop under display spotlights.
examples.zh: 用骨白色在每片裝甲邊緣小心勾勒出一道極細邊緣高光，在展覽燈下極具視覺衝擊。

examples.en: The breathtaking drum solo performance was undeniably the highlight of the two-hour rock concert.
examples.zh: 那段技驚四座、驚心動魄的現場爵士鼓獨奏橋段，毫無疑問是整場長達兩小時搖滾演唱會的最精彩高潮亮點。

examples.en: Use a bright fluorescent yellow marker to highlight crucial legal definitions inside the textbook.
examples.zh: 拿起醒目的螢光黃亮色螢光筆，在厚厚的法學教科書中標註畫記出最核心關鍵的法律構成要件定義。

words.definition: 半透明薄釉疊色漸層技法

examples.en: Multiple micro-layers of semi-transparent glazing create silky smooth color transitions on cloth capes.
examples.zh: 透過反覆堆疊十餘層極其稀薄的半透明薄釉層，在斗篷布料上創造出如絲綢般的無縫漸層。

examples.en: Modern commercial skyscrapers use energy-efficient double glazing windows to minimize solar heat transfer.
examples.zh: 當代現代化玻璃帷幕商辦摩天大樓，全面採用節能隔熱的雙層中空雙層玻璃窗，將戶外烈日熱能阻隔在外。

examples.en: The baker brushed a sweet honey glazing over the freshly baked apple pastries to give them a glossy sheen.
examples.zh: 烘焙糕點師傅在剛出爐的酥脆蘋果派表面均勻刷上一層晶瑩剔透的蜂蜜糖漿淋醬釉光，散發迷人光彩。

words.definition: 非金屬金屬色 (NMM 手繪金屬反光)

examples.en: The master painter painted glowing golden reflections on the sword using non-metallic metal (NMM) techniques.
examples.zh: 塗裝大師完全不使用亮粉金屬漆，純粹用黃褐色手繪出反光倒影的非金屬金屬色神技。

examples.en: Ceramics, plastics, and untreated woods are common non-metallic materials found in everyday households.
examples.zh: 陶瓷茶具碗盤、環保塑膠容器與天然原木家具，都是現代日常居家生活中隨處可見的典型非金屬材質材料。

examples.en: Achieving convincing non-metallic metal illusions requires understanding how ambient light reflects off sharp edges.
examples.zh: 想要繪製出令人信服且真假難辨的手繪非金屬光澤效果，必須深刻掌握自然環境光線在金屬折角處的物理反光規律。

words.definition: 軍事模型舊化戰損風化技法

examples.en: Masterful tank weathering tells a silent story of mud splatters, exhaust stains, and blazing sun exposure.
examples.zh: 爐火純青的戰車舊化技法，無聲訴說著泥漿噴濺、廢氣薰黑與烈日風化的戰場故事。

examples.en: Centuries of wind and rain weathering have sculpted the coastal sandstone cliffs into dramatic mushroom shapes.
examples.zh: 數百年來大自然無情的風雨侵蝕與海風風化洗禮，將野柳濱海的沉積砂岩雕鑿成形態各異的壯麗蕈狀岩石奇觀。

examples.en: Applying oil washes and dry pigments simulates years of realistic operational weathering on freight locomotives.
examples.zh: 巧妙運用舊化油畫顏料漬洗液與天然礦物粉彩，能逼真模擬出鐵路柴油貨運火車頭歷經多年風霜的歲月舊化痕跡。

words.definition: 掉漆海綿點塗與定型液掉漆效果

examples.en: Dabbing dark grey paint with a blister sponge simulates realistic paint chipping on tank hatches.
examples.zh: 用高密度海綿沾取深灰色顏料輕點在艙門邊緣，能逼真模擬出裝甲漆面遭磕碰刮擦的掉漆效果。

examples.en: Golfers practice their close-range chipping technique to land balls softly near the pin.
examples.zh: 高爾夫球愛好者在果嶺練習場反覆琢磨近距離起切球短打技巧，力求讓小白球輕柔停在球洞旗桿旁。

examples.en: Chipping old cracked tiles off the bathroom floor is the noisy first step of home renovation.
examples.zh: 拿著電動鑿碎工具將浴室地面殘破龜裂的老舊舊磁磚一一敲碎剔除，是老屋衛浴翻新裝修工程的第一道工序。

words.definition: 斑駁鐵鏽流鏽效果；生鏽

examples.en: Streaking orange oil pigments downwards simulates realistic rain-washed rust running down steel armor.
examples.zh: 將橙褐色油畫顏料垂直向下輕輕暈染，能生動呈現鋼鐵裝甲遭雨水沖刷流淌而下的流鏽效果。

examples.en: Leaving garden tools outdoors in the rain causes exposed iron blades to develop orange coat of rust.
examples.zh: 將五金園藝修枝剪隨意遺落在戶外淋雨，會使外露的金屬鐵刃迅速生成一層毛茸茸的橙紅色鐵鏽鏽斑。

examples.en: After years of retirement, his conversational English had gathered a bit of rust from lack of daily practice.
examples.zh: 光榮退休定居鄉間多年之後，由於平時缺乏日常開口對話機會，他原本流暢的外語口條難免顯得有些生疏生鏽。

words.definition: 履帶厚重泥漿泥濘立體紋理膏

examples.en: Mixing texture paste with brown pigments and static grass produces heavy clumpy mud stuck to tank tracks.
examples.zh: 將紋理石膏膏體與深褐色顏料、碎草絲均勻攪拌，能做出死死卡在履帶縫隙中的厚重泥濘。

examples.en: Children laughed joyfully as they splashed through muddy brown puddles in their waterproof rubber boots.
examples.zh: 小朋友們腳踩著五顏六色的防水橡膠小雨鞋，歡呼雀躍地在下雨後的泥濘水坑中盡情踩水嬉戲。

examples.en: Off-road rally racers must navigate deep mud ruts without losing wheel traction on unpaved mountain roads.
examples.zh: 越野拉力賽車手在蜿蜒險峻的非鋪裝山路賽道上馳騁時，必須沉著操控方向盤衝過深深的泥巴車轍而不打滑失控。

words.definition: 情境透視立體場景模型

examples.en: The award-winning diorama depicts a ruined European village complete with shattered bricks and cobblestones.
examples.zh: 這座國際獲獎情境立體場景，以斷壁殘垣、碎磚瓦礫與鵝卵石街道生動重現歐洲戰場廢墟。

examples.en: Elementary students constructed a shoe-box diorama illustrating a dense Amazon rainforest ecosystem.
examples.zh: 國小學童發揮無窮想像力，利用回收鞋盒親手組裝出一座立體情境透視模型，生動呈現亞馬遜雨林生態。

examples.en: Natural history museums employ scenic artists to craft three-dimensional background dioramas for animal exhibits.
examples.zh: 國立自然史博物館延聘頂尖造景藝術家，為各大常設動物標本展示櫥窗精心打造栩栩如生的三維全景背景模型。

words.definition: 雕刻石膏懸崖岩壁造景；熟石膏

examples.en: Pouring liquid Hydrocal plaster into rubber rock molds creates lightweight, highly detailed cliff faces.
examples.zh: 將超硬石膏漿料注入矽膠岩石模具中，脫模後即可組合成重量輕且紋理極其立體的壯麗懸崖峭壁。

examples.en: The emergency physician applied a rigid white plaster cast around the teenager’s fractured wrist.
examples.zh: 急診室主治醫師熟練地用浸濕的白色醫用石膏繃帶，將這位骨折少年的受損手腕牢牢包覆固定。

examples.en: Traditional artisans spread lime plaster smoothly across interior walls to provide breathable humidity regulation.
examples.zh: 傳統手作泥作匠人將天然熟石灰石膏灰漿均勻推抹於室內牆壁上，提供兼具呼吸透氣與天然防潮的優質壁面。

words.definition: 靜電植草機 (讓仿真草絲垂直站立)

examples.en: An electrostatic static grass applicator charges nylon fibers, making them stand perfectly upright in wet PVA glue.
examples.zh: 運用靜電植草機釋放高壓靜電，讓尼龍草絲在白膠上一根根筆直挺立如真實草地。

examples.en: Rubbing a balloon vigorously against your dry wool sweater generates playful static electricity.
examples.zh: 將橡膠充氣氣球在乾燥的純羊毛毛衣上快速摩擦數十下，便能瞬間產生足以吸附頭髮的趣味靜電現象。

examples.en: In this fast-changing competitive market, resting on past laurels and remaining static leads to failure.
examples.zh: 在這個瞬息萬變且競爭激烈的現代商業戰場中，倘若故步自封、安於現狀而停滯不前，終將難逃被市場淘汰的命運。

words.definition: 樹冠樹葉海綿草粉植被植絨

examples.en: Gluing colored sponge flocking onto twisted wire armature frames creates realistic miniature autumn trees.
examples.zh: 將細緻染色的海綿草粉植絨黏貼在纏繞的銅絲樹枝骨架上，打造出逼真秋色微縮大樹。

examples.en: The jewelry presentation box was lined with velvety green flocking to protect gold necklaces from scratches.
examples.zh: 高級珠寶展示首飾盒內襯全面鋪設了如天鵝絨般柔軟的翠綠植絨絨面，以防金飾項鍊在運送中刮傷。

examples.en: Hundreds of migratory birds were seen flocking together over the marshland before their southward flight.
examples.zh: 數以百計的北歸候鳥在濕地上空盤旋集結成群結隊成龐大鳥群，準備整隊踏上漫長艱辛的南遷越冬航程。

words.definition: 環氧樹脂透明造水流水浪花造景

examples.en: Pouring tinted two-part clear epoxy resin creates crystalline mountain streams with realistic water depths.
examples.zh: 緩慢澆注微調染色的雙劑型透明環氧樹脂，能製作出清澈見底、具備深淺層次的山澗溪流。

examples.en: Pine trees secrete natural aromatic resin from bark cuts to seal injuries against destructive fungal decay.
examples.zh: 松樹在樹幹受損時會自然從割破的樹皮處分泌出芳香濃稠的松樹脂，以抵禦外來黴菌感染並封閉傷口。

examples.en: Crafters love using UV resin to make handmade transparent jewelry with embedded dried flowers.
examples.zh: 文創手作愛好者熱衷於使用紫外線快乾滴膠 UV 樹脂，將浪漫的天然乾燥花瓣永久封存製作成晶瑩吊墜。

words.definition: 4K/8K 光固化光敏樹脂 3D 列印的

examples.en: Photoreactive resin solidifies instantly under ultraviolet laser projections in desktop SLA 3D printers.
examples.zh: 8K 桌面光固化 3D 列印機中的光敏樹脂，在紫外線雷射投影下瞬間逐層凝固成型。

examples.en: Store uncured photoreactive liquid polymer bottles in opaque, light-proof containers away from window sills.
examples.zh: 請將尚未開封或使用完畢的光敏樹脂化學液體，妥善保存在完全不透光的避光密封瓶中並遠離窗台陽光。

examples.en: Dental clinics utilize photoreactive composite materials cured with special blue curing lights to fill cavities.
examples.zh: 現代牙醫診所在為病患填補蛀牙牙洞時，廣泛使用以特製高能藍光照射即可秒級固化的光反應光敏複合樹脂。

words.definition: 八微米超高列印解析度；解析度

examples.en: High 8K resolution eliminates visible print layer lines, producing flawless miniature facial expressions.
examples.zh: 高達 8K 的極致列印解析度，能徹底消除肉眼可見的層紋階梯，印出栩栩如生的精緻微表情。

examples.en: Making a New Year's resolution to exercise three times each week is a wonderful habit for personal health.
examples.zh: 在元旦清晨許下每週至少規律運動三次的新年新希望決心，是維持個人長久身心健康的絕佳好習慣。

examples.en: Peaceful diplomatic negotiations led to a prompt and amicable resolution of the cross-border trade dispute.
examples.zh: 經過多輪冷靜克制的外交斡旋協商，終於促成了這起跨國雙邊貿易摩擦爭端的迅速圓滿解決化解。

words.definition: 細心剪除列印支撐結構；支撐

examples.en: Using hot water softens resin contact tips, allowing micro supports to snap off cleanly without gouges.
examples.zh: 將列印件浸泡在熱水中軟化接觸點，能讓微型列印支撐結構一撥即落且不留深坑凹洞。

examples.en: Strong concrete support pillars were placed strategically beneath the ceiling of the underground parking garage.
examples.zh: 在地下多功能立體停車場的天花板下方，科學佈設了數根堅固粗壯的鋼筋混凝土支撐柱作為垂直承重支柱。

examples.en: Family members offered unwavering moral and financial support while she pursued her second medical degree.
examples.zh: 在她毅然辭職重返校園攻讀第二個醫學博士學位期間，全體家庭成員給予了她毫無保留的精神鼓勵與經濟資助。

words.definition: 超音波異丙醇零件清洗機的

examples.en: An ultrasonic cleaner filled with ninety-nine percent isopropyl alcohol dissolves uncured sticky surface resin.
examples.zh: 將列印完的模型放入裝滿異丙醇的超音波清洗機中，徹底震落表面未固化的多餘樹脂。

examples.en: Bats utilize ultrasonic echolocation calls pitched far beyond the threshold of human auditory perception.
examples.zh: 蝙蝠在暗夜空中自由穿梭，利用頻率遠遠超出人類耳朵聽力感知極限的超音波回聲定位機制精準飛行。

examples.en: Obstetricians use harmless diagnostic ultrasonic waves to monitor fetal development inside the womb.
examples.zh: 婦產科專科醫師運用完全無游離輻射的產前醫療超音波影像技術，細心監測子宮內小胎兒的成長發育指針。

words.definition: 紫外線二次固化箱 (增強硬度)

examples.en: A rotating turntable inside the UV curing chamber ensures complete, even polymer strength across the figure.
examples.zh: 在紫外線固化箱的旋轉轉盤上均勻照射紫外光，確保模型每個角落達到最高強度與韌性。

examples.en: Traditional butcher shops rely on salt curing and cold smoking to preserve hams for months without refrigeration.
examples.zh: 傳統鄉村肉品醃製老店依循古法鹽醃醃漬與低溫煙燻工藝，讓頂級風乾火腿無需冷藏即可長效保鮮數月。

examples.en: The concrete foundation requires a seven-day water curing period to achieve its maximum structural compressive hardness.
examples.zh: 剛澆置完成的建築水泥混凝土基礎，必須歷經連續七天的灑水保濕養護固化期，方能達到最高的抗壓強度。

words.definition: 精密黃銅金屬光刻蝕刻片組件的

examples.en: Replacing thick plastic engine grilles with brass photo-etched metal mesh adds authentic scale fidelity.
examples.zh: 將塑膠射出厚重散熱網換成厚度僅 0.1 毫米的黃銅金屬蝕刻片改造件，大幅提升像真度。

examples.en: The traumatic memory of the catastrophic earthquake remained permanently etched into his childhood memories.
examples.zh: 當年那場毀天滅地的強烈大地震所帶來的驚恐震撼景象，永久深刻地銘刻烙印在他童年的腦海深處。

examples.en: The glassblower presented a decorative crystal vase featuring delicately etched bamboo motifs.
examples.zh: 吹製玻璃工藝大師親手呈獻了一只精雕細琢的水晶花瓶，瓶身表面細膩雕刻著栩栩如生的清雅竹林圖騰。

words.definition: 模型水貼紙 (附軟化劑服貼刻線)

examples.en: Applying decal softener makes thin waterslide decals melt conformably into recessed rivets and panel lines.
examples.zh: 塗抹水貼專用軟化劑能讓薄如蟬翼的水貼紙完美軟化並服貼於複雜的鉚釘與凹凸刻線之中。

examples.en: The racing team applied bright sponsor decals and national flags onto the sports car hood.
examples.zh: 國際賽車競速車隊在流線型跑車引擎蓋與車門兩側，整齊貼上了醒目的贊助商商標水貼與國旗標誌。

examples.en: Always soak the waterslide decal in lukewarm water for thirty seconds until it slides freely off the backing sheet.
examples.zh: 將模型水貼紙浸入溫水中靜置約三十秒，直到微薄貼紙能在藍色底紙上自由滑動時即可用鑷子精準移貼。

words.definition: 消光透明保護漆 (消除反光統一光澤)

examples.en: Spraying an ultra-matte topcoat eliminates plastic shine, sealing the miniature's delicate paint layers permanently.
examples.zh: 噴塗上一層超霧面消光透明保護漆，能徹底消除塑料反光並永久封存細緻的顏料層。

examples.en: A stylish wool topcoat worn over a crisp suit provides both warmth and timeless elegance on chilly city mornings.
examples.zh: 在筆挺的合身西裝外搭一件剪裁俐落的長版羊毛大衣外套，在寒冷的都會清晨兼具極佳保暖與非凡紳士品味。

examples.en: Applying a clear high-gloss topcoat over nail polish protects the manicure against accidental chipping.
examples.zh: 在剛做好的美甲指甲油表面均勻刷塗一層晶瑩剔透的高光亮油頂層面油保護層，能有效預防指彩刮花掉漆。

words.definition: LED 環形放大鏡工作檯燈的

examples.en: Working under a lighted desktop magnifying lamp allows artists to paint tiny eyeballs less than one millimeter wide.
examples.zh: 在配備高亮 LED 的放大鏡工作燈下專注作畫，讓塗裝師能為小於一毫米的眼珠點睛。

examples.en: The watchmaker clamped a jeweler’s magnifying loupe to his eye to inspect tiny gears inside the movement.
examples.zh: 瑞士高級鐘錶匠人將專業高倍率珠寶鐘錶放大鏡牢牢夾在眼眶前，凝神檢視機械機芯內部微小的齒輪咬合。

examples.en: Looking through the magnifying lens revealed intricate microscopic veins running through the emerald leaf.
examples.zh: 透過高解析光學放大鏡仔細端詳，翠綠欲滴的樹葉內部那如網絡般密布的微觀葉脈脈絡瞬間清晰可見。

words.definition: 屏氣凝神之靈巧手眼協調度

examples.en: Micro-painting demands extraordinary manual dexterity, resting both wrists firmly against the workbench edge.
examples.zh: 繪製微縮模型極度考驗靈巧細膩的手眼協調敏捷度，需將雙手手腕穩穩支撐在桌緣屏氣落筆。

examples.en: Performing delicate neurosurgery requires remarkable mental calm and precise finger dexterity under pressure.
examples.zh: 執刀進行高風險的顯微神經外科開腦手術，極度考驗主刀醫師在高壓環境下泰然自若的心境與指尖極限靈巧度。

examples.en: Playing fingerstyle acoustic guitar trains independent digital dexterity across all five fingers of the right hand.
examples.zh: 練習原聲木吉他指彈演奏風格，能扎實訓練右手五根手指各自獨立撥弦的精準協調度與敏捷度。

words.definition: 數十小時精雕細琢之無比耐心

examples.en: Model building is a therapeutic pursuit rewarding infinite patience, discipline, and attention to detail.
examples.zh: 靜心製作模型是一場心靈療癒之旅，回饋給製作者的是無比的耐心、自律與對細節的專注。

examples.en: Caring for an energetic young puppy demands tremendous love, consistency, and endless patience.
examples.zh: 悉心照料一隻活力旺盛、好奇調皮的幼犬，需要飼主傾注無盡的愛心、原則以及無比的包容耐心。

examples.en: Fishing on a quiet lake teaches anglers how to cultivate deep mental patience while waiting for bites.
examples.zh: 獨自駕舟徜徉在清幽靜謐的湖泊上垂釣，教會了每一位釣客如何在靜心等候魚兒上鉤的漫長過程中涵養深沉定力。

words.definition: 栩栩如生極致寫實擬真度

examples.en: The subtle layering of dust, oil stains, and chipping achieves a level of lifelike realism that deceives the eye.
examples.zh: 灰塵、油漬與掉漆的細膩層次疊加，達到了真假難辨、令人嘆為觀止的極致寫實擬真度。

examples.en: The nineteenth-century literary movement of realism rejected romantic melodrama in favor of everyday human truth.
examples.zh: 十九世紀歐洲興起的現實主義文學浪潮，斷然揚棄了矯揉造作的浪漫抒情，轉而深刻描寫市井小民真實生活的客觀現實。

examples.en: Modern video game graphics engines use real-time ray tracing to achieve uncanny visual photorealism.
examples.zh: 頂級電玩次世代遊戲圖形引擎導入即時光線追蹤演算技術，在虛擬場景中達到了令人震撼的逼真照片級擬真寫實度。

words.definition: 凝結歷史瞬間的微縮敘事張力

examples.en: The diorama's emotional narrative captures tired soldiers sharing a quiet laugh beside a campfire.
examples.zh: 這座微縮場景蘊含著深沉動人的敘事張力，定格了疲憊戰士在營火旁相視一笑的溫暖瞬間。

examples.en: The best-selling novel weaves a complex, multi-perspective narrative spanning three generations of an immigrant family.
examples.zh: 這本轟動文壇的暢銷經典小說，巧妙編織出一套跨越三代移民家族愛恨糾葛、視角宏大多元的精彩歷史敘事史詩。

examples.en: Marketing directors understand that an authentic brand narrative builds lasting emotional loyalty with consumers.
examples.zh: 卓越的品牌行銷總監深知：唯有一套真誠不造作、打動人心的品牌故事敘事核心，才能與廣大消費者建立長遠深厚的情感共鳴。

words.definition: 掌中方寸微觀奇幻大千世界

examples.en: Building a miniature town creates an enchanting microcosm where every little house tells a charming story.
examples.zh: 搭建一座微縮歐風小鎮彷彿親手創造出一個迷人的微觀大千世界，每棟小房子都有故事。

examples.en: The diverse university campus serves as a microcosm of global society, uniting students from over eighty nations.
examples.zh: 這所多元開放的知名國際大學校園宛如整個全球縮影的生動微觀世界，匯聚了來自世界八十多個國家的優秀青年學子。

examples.en: A single tidal rock pool functions as a thriving biological microcosm teeming with tiny crabs, anemones, and algae.
examples.zh: 濱海礁岩潮間帶上的一個天然小潮池，本身就是一個充滿生機的微觀生態系統，棲息著成群的微小寄居蟹、海葵與海藻。

words.definition: 畢生熱愛微縮模型之模型達人職人

examples.en: The dedicated model artisan spends months researching historical photographs before cutting a single plastic sprue.
examples.zh: 這位追求極致的模型達人職人，在下刀剪開零件前會耗費數月考證泛黃歷史照片。

examples.en: The sleepy hillside village is renowned for skilled artisans who weave intricate bamboo baskets and hats.
examples.zh: 這座掩映在翠綠山林間的幽靜山村，以村內多位身懷絕技、能親手編織出巧奪天工竹籃與竹笠的竹編手工藝匠人而名聞遐邇。

examples.en: Supporting local food artisans preserves ancestral cheese-making and bread-baking culinary traditions.
examples.zh: 大力支持在地友善小農與傳統食品手工工匠，能有效保護世代相傳的天然乳酪發酵與古法歐式麵包烘焙文化遺產。

words.definition: 博物館殿堂級情境模型傳世傑作

examples.en: Crowned champion at the international expo, his diorama stands as an undisputed miniature masterpiece.
examples.zh: 在世界模型公開賽中斬獲全場總冠軍，這座耗時兩年打造的立體情境模型無疑是一件無可爭議的傳世傑作。

examples.en: Michelangelo spent four grueling years painting the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel, creating an immortal artistic masterpiece.
examples.zh: 米開朗基羅耗費整整四年極其艱辛的仰臥歲月，在西斯汀禮拜堂天頂繪製出舉世震驚、名垂青史的藝術傳世巔峰傑作。

examples.en: Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 is widely revered as an eternal masterpiece celebrating universal human brotherhood.
examples.zh: 貝多芬的《第九號交響曲合唱》，被全球愛樂者一致尊奉為歌頌全人類四海一家、博愛平等的永恆音樂巔峰傑作。
